name: Security industry licensing
what: Hold a state security licence for guarding, crowd control, installation or investigation work, usually issued by police.

layers.who: State police or security licensing agency
State police or security licensing agency

basis.source: 5-year Productivity Inquiry: A more productive labour market (volume 7)
basis.quote: security licences through the Commissioner of Police

issues.what: State regulators take different approaches to security training and qualifications, which led to licence shopping between states and extra checks on interstate applicants.

evidence.quote: The emergence of such widespread shopping and hopping stems from differences between occupational regulators in their approach to training qualifications and standards.
